Open /program-builder?edit=<id> (or however edit is routed — check ProgramBuilder.jsx for the editId query param name). 3. Change one field (e.g. a rep target) and tap 'Save Changes'. 4. title: Re-enroll in a program after Restart — does progression_state actually reset, or carry over stale working weights
